title: The Fractional Half Dirac Operator Over Sobolev Spaces
summary: Let a bounded and smooth domain in the n dimensional Euclidean space be given and consider a boundary value problem of the half order Dirac operator and its power, with f be the value of the half derivative of the solution in the domain and, g be the trace value of the solution over the boundary.
